title: verify: signed_attrs re-encoded as SET not [0] IMPLICIT for signature input
description: NOT A BUG: The cms crate stores signed_attrs as Attributes (SetOfVec) and SignedAttributes::to_der() produces tag 0x31 (SET). The [0] IMPLICIT tag is only used when encoding/decoding within the SignerInfo SEQUENCE. When to_der() is called directly on the SignedAttributes value, it produces the canonical 0x31-tagged SET encoding required by RFC 5652 §5.4. Confirmed by test_verify_openssl_rsa_signed passing.
